description:
Nacchan: I joined because I was interested in animation and space. I can write simple programs and draw illustrations.

Komachan: I have always been interested in stars, so I decided to participate because I wanted to take part in a NASA project.

Jun-chan: I have been interested in and fascinated by space since I was little.

Ki-chan: I am familiar with using AI tools. Although I still have limited experience in programming and space exploration, my motivation and determination are second to none.
